title: Operations Analyst
description:
*The Role: Morningstar seeks an Operations Analyst to join our Global Performance analytics team. This will be a key role in our mission to provide exceptional client experience by ensuring our production and operational processes are efficient and effective. This position is based in our Mumbai office.*
**Responsibilities**

* Produce Quarterly, Monthly, Weekly and Daily reports for Fund performance and Peer fund comparison analysis based on Morningstar Direct.
* Produce Excel based Performance, Attribution and Risk reporting
* Troubleshoot outliers and correct rate of return discrepancies as needed
* Validate index/ benchmark/asset pricing/ and the resulting returns
* Retrieve and validate data from various source/vendor systems and upload to the Morningstar’s applications.
* Address ad-hoc performance inquiries from internal and external parties
* Assist and support on Firm’s annual GIPS verification
* Attribution reporting (i.e. absolute and relative portfolio performance to factors including security selection, asset allocation, currency, etc.)

*Competencies*

* Strong communication skills
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills
* Attention to Detail
* Methodical Problem-Solving Skills
* Excellent Organization Skills (Email, Task Management, Follow-up)
* Self-Motivated
* Goal Oriented
* Team Player

**Requirements**

* 1 – 3 years of working experience in Financial Operations domain
* Ready to work flexible hours, alongside US ,UK and Australia based colleagues for production and other issues that require immediate escalation and/or resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English.
* Excellent skills in Microsoft Excel.

*Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer*
Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
description:
**Morningstar Indexes**
- http://indexes.morningstar.com
  
  
**Position**
: Senior Quantitative Analyst – New Product Development – Morningstar Indexes
  
  
**The Area:**
Morningstar Indexes Team leverages its expertise in equity research, manager research, asset allocation, and portfolio construction to create innovative investment solutions. We use Morningstar’s intellectual property to create indexes that empower investors to achieve their goals at every stage of the investment process - market monitoring, benchmarking, and asset allocation. Morningstar Indexes offers a broad suite of global equity, bond, commodity and asset allocation indexes.
  
  
**The Role:**
As a part of the New Product Development Team, you will participate in the full development cycle including ideation, design, development, presentations to global research team and clients, leading up to implementation. A fast-growing dynamic set-up offers opportunity to handle multiple projects, work with diverse and skilled team members and provide opportunities to fast track your career development. You will have a good grasp of investment concepts, possess strong analytical skills, good communication skills and will be technically proficient with at least one programming language (Python, R or MATLAB) in addition to SQL. This position is based in our Navi Mumbai office.
  
  
**Responsibilities**




+ Build innovative index solutions through rigorous investment research, and own it through full product development lifecycle from ideation, design, development, and validation, leading up to launch
+ Collaborate effectively with the broader Morningstar research organization including equity, quantitative, manager or sustainability research teams, and product management to develop novel thematic and smart beta indexes that leverage Morningstar IP
+ Promote integration of team throughput and operational processes with other index teams to facilitate growth of our product and methodology suite
+ Help develop new tools and capabilities to perform portfolio construction or analytics independently, including the use of statistical and machine learning techniques
+ Publish white papers, factsheets, client presentations, and other collateral to support go-to-market plans

**Requirements**




+ At least 3 years of experience in a quantitative or financial domain such as equity research, credit research, investment management, risk management, or analytics
+ Bachelor’s degree in quantitative, financial discipline, or engineering, MBA/Masters degree is helpful
+ CFA charter or candidature (at least passed Level II) is desirable
+ Knowledge of investment concepts, modern portfolio theory, and portfolio construction processes.
+ Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Matlab, R or C#)
+ Excellent documentation habits, oral and written communication and presentation skills including ability to distil complex ideas into simple explanations

Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
Morningstar’s hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to work remotely and collaborate in-person each week. We’ve found that we’re at our best when we’re purposely together on a regular basis, at least four days each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you’ll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Labeling Data and Quality Analyst
description:
**Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a**
Labeling Data and Quality Analyst
  
  
**What We Do**
At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.
  
  
**Role Reports To**
Project Leader - Global R&D Systems
  
  
**Location:**
Asia Pacific, India, Maharashtra, Greater Mumbai
  
  
**Work Location:**
Hybrid
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Key Focus Areas**

* Audit and validate labeling annotation data for accuracy, consistency and guideline adherence
* Identify, document and report errors and root cause triggers to management and stakeholders
* Monitor quality KPIs (Right First Time rates, rework triggers) and drive monthly governance cycles
* Translate data trends into actionable process improvement plans across agencies and internal teams
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and safety requirements throughout the labeling process
* Lead NC Program

**Profile Summary**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience in Data Science/Computer Science.
* 2–4 years of experience in data analytics, root-cause analysis, or quality assurance .
* Relevant experience in FMCG, Pharma, or Healthcare domains is required
* Experience working with APAC and/or EMEA markets is a strong plus
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Analytics and Visualization, ETL and Data Engineering.
* Proficient in PowerBI, Python and Data Modeling techniques.
* Excellent communication skills across stakeholder levels

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with AI data preprocessing, Building Agents, Power Platform
* Familiarity with labeling annotation tools and processes

If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.
